summary: SINTX Technologies filed an 8-K reporting completion of a warrant call: call notices delivered October 1, 2026 to holders of Class B common stock purchase warrants, with the call period expiring 5:00 p.m. ET October 8, 2026. The company received aggregate gross proceeds of $2,014,645.22 from exercises and related exchanges covering 941,423 Class B warrant shares at $2.14 per share. It issued 651,204 common shares and, to accommodate 9.99% beneficial ownership limits, fully pre-funded warrants for 290,219 shares; remaining Class B warrants expired worthless. No Class B warrants remain; Class A warrants were unaffected. Post-issuance shares outstanding totaled 7,558,073 as of October 9, 2026. Watch residual dilution from pre-funded warrants and any future Class A warrant call.
